remarks: HIGHEST & BEST by Wednesday at 5PM. Experience the ultimate coastal lifestyle in this detached townhouse located just steps from Cove Island Beach and Park. The main level offers an expansive living room centered by a wood-burning fireplace, flowing seamlessly into an updated kitchen complete with quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and an abundance of cabinetry, as well as a dining area that opens to a private patio, ideal for relaxing or entertaining. The second floor features a large primary suite with its own bathroom and walk-in closet, a convenient laundry room, and two additional bedrooms that share a full bathroom. On the uppermost floor, two oversized rooms offer incredible versatility as potential bedrooms, a rec room, or a home office. This home also includes a one-car garage, a dedicated driveway for extra parking, and a large unfinished lower level that offers endless possibilities, along with central air conditioning and natural gas heating, all conveniently located near parks, the beach, and public transportation.
